    n = int(data[0])
    q = int(data[1])
    s = data[2].decode()
    # P[i] = number of p in [1..i] with S_p == S_{p+1}, 1-indexed
    P = [0] * (n + 1)
    cnt = 0

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()

    q = int(data[1])
    s = data[2].decode()
    # pre[i] = number of matches among 0-indexed pairs with index < i
    pre = [0] * (n + 1)
    cnt = 0
    for i in range(n):
        # pair index i: s[i] == s[i+1], valid for i <= n-2
        if i <= n - 2 and s[i] == s[i + 1]:
            cnt += 1
        pre[i + 1] = cnt
    out = []
    idx = 3
    for _ in range(q):
        l = int(data[idx]); r = int(data[idx + 1])
        idx += 2
        out.append(pre[r - 1] - pre[l - 1])
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(map(str, out)) + "\n")

def main():

    n = int(data[0])
    q = int(data[1])
    s = data[2].decode()
    # P[k] = number of j in [1, k] with s[j-1] == s[j] (1-indexed j, S_j == S_{j+1})
    P = [0] * (n + 1)
    cnt = 0
    for j in range(1, n + 1):
        # d[j] for j in 1..n-1
        if j <= n - 1 and s[j - 1] == s[j]:
            cnt += 1
        P[j] = cnt
    out = []
    idx = 3
    for _ in range(q):
        l = int(data[idx]); r = int(data[idx + 1])
        idx += 2
        out.append(P[r - 1] - P[l - 1])
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(map(str, out)) + "\n")
